name: bug
description: Something is broken or behaving incorrectly.

name: needs-triage
description: Needs maintainer review and initial categorization.

name: needs-more-info
description: Waiting on the reporter. Closes after 7 days without a reply.

name: vouch:trusted
description: Author has write access or is vouched in .github/VOUCHED.td.

name: vouch:unvouched
description: Author is not yet vouched in .github/VOUCHED.td.

name: needs-rebase
description: Conflicts with its base branch. Closes after 7 days without activity.

name: triage:closing
description: Breaks a contribution rule. Closes 72 hours after the notice without activity.

name: triage:keep-open
description: A maintainer keeps this open; automated closing leaves it alone.

name: triage:ready
description: Passed contribution triage and waits for maintainer review.

name: size:XS
description: 0-9 effective changed lines (test files excluded in mixed PRs).

name: size:S
description: 10-29 effective changed lines (test files excluded in mixed PRs).

name: size:M
description: 30-99 effective changed lines (test files excluded in mixed PRs).

name: size:L
description: 100-499 effective changed lines (test files excluded in mixed PRs).

name: size:XL
description: 500-999 effective changed lines (test files excluded in mixed PRs).

name: size:XXL
description: 1,000+ effective changed lines (test files excluded in mixed PRs).

name: agent-context-increase
description: A maintainer accepts that this PR grows the context every agent session loads.
